sections.title: Local spares
sections.text: We hold the agency and stock spares locally, which is what makes our maintenance commitments credible.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Keckonn supplies industrial valves and valve automation for gas and process service. We hold the agency, specify the right valve and actuator for the duty, and stock spares locally so a station is never waiting on a long import lead time for a routine part.

items.title: Ball & plug valves
items.text: Quarter-turn isolation for gas and liquid service, soft- and metal-seated, in the pressure classes used on transmission and distribution.

items.title: Gate, globe & check valves
items.text: Isolation, throttling and non-return valves for process and utility lines.

items.title: Actuators & automation
items.text: Pneumatic, gas-over-oil, electric and manual gear operators, with limit switches and positioners for remote and automated control.

sections.title: The valve is only half the job
sections.subtitle: Selection, actuation and spares decide whether it keeps working.
paragraphs: We match valve and actuator to the service conditions, supply them as part of the skid or station scope, and keep common spares in country — so maintenance is a same-week job, not an import project.
